Petitioners
 Through: Mr. Ram Gopal Sharma, Mr. Kapil
 Kaushik and Mr. Yash, Advs.
 alongwith petitioners in person.

versus
 The State Nct Of Delhi And Anr .....

Respondents
 Through: Mr. Pradeep Gahalot, App for the
 State with Si Rinku, Ps Bawana.

Mr. M.K. Duggal, Adv. for R-2 with
 R-2 Ms. Preeti in person.

Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
 Order

This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.215/2013 registered under Sections 406/498A IPC at PS Bawana, on the ground of a settlement between the parties vide settlement deed dated 28.03.2022, which is on record of this Court and was arrived at with the facilitation of the Delhi Mediation Centre, Rohini District Courts.

As per the settlement, a balance amount of Rs.6.5 Lakhs is being tendered at this stage, vide a DD bearing No.003601 dated 21.03.2023 for Rs.6,50,000/- to the respondent No.2, who has received it in the Court and acknowledged the same.
2. Petitioner Nos.1 - 6 and respondent No.2/complainant are present in the Court, duly identified by the counsel and the IO.
Respondent No.2 confirms that there is no further amount to be received.
3. Petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 were married on 09.02.2010 and one female child was born out of the wedlock.
However, due to differences, their marriage has resulted in a divorce vide a decree dated 26.07.2022.

4. Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.215/2013 registered under Sections 406/498A IPC at PS Bawana, and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
It is however made clear that the said settlement will not affect the rights of the minor child in future.
